{{Top|leg}}
'''Trakkrrrn''' were creatures from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Their meat was considered to be rather spicy. [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] enjoyed eating [[barbecued trakkrrrn ribs]].
